coverage.summary: Citywide in San Diego. Covers residential rental property in the City. Division 11 takes that term from S.D. Mun. Code § 98.0702, which defines it as any dwelling or unit intended for human habitation, including any dwelling or unit in a mobilehome park. Division 11 states no unit-count, building-age or owner-occupancy limits.
coverage.other_conditions: Landlord, lease, residential rental property and tenant take their definitions from S.D. Mun. Code § 98.0702. Under § 98.0702, landlord includes an owner and any person with the right to offer residential rental property for rent. Division 11 incorporates only the § 98.0702 definitions. The § 98.0703 exemptions are expressly limited to Division 7. The Division 7 exemptions are therefore not carried over, including the 15-year certificate-of-occupancy exemption and the owner-occupancy exemptions.

result.notes: Removed the clause 'Applies only to software using nonpublic competitor data' from other_conditions. It describes the regulated device and landlord conduct, not buildings, units or owners, and is already covered in requirement and exemptions. Removed the summary statement that the rule applies to sellers and licensors of devices, which is also conduct. The summary now describes the covered property using the incorporated § 98.0702 definition. The finding that the § 98.0703 exemptions do not apply rests on two passages. § 98.1102 incorporates only the § 98.0702 definitions. § 98.0703 limits its exemptions to 'This Division', meaning Division 7. requires_unknown_facts is kept as false because coverage reaches any residential rental property in the City and turns on no building facts. All other coverage fields stay null; the Division 11 text has no unit-count, construction-date, building-age or owner-size thresholds.
